protocol.training: Every ETday00:00 rebuild each clock from expanding complete whole-date chronological prefix matched across all3pairs/all eligible clocks. Stop at first unmatured date, never skip unknown labels. At least120 real dates perclock. Date weights half-life126, normalized sum N then divided equally by3pairs; duplicated rows do not increase real N. Own pair weighted centers/scales/intercepts. Query current state never enters training. Base model output C±D is expected log net return, not success probability.

protocol.transform: At each day00ET, for each pair/clock use only same matched mature-prefix rows to compute original18 weighted means/population SD (SD<1e-12=>1). Transform z=(x-mean)/SD, then concatenate18z and all171 products zi*zj with i<=j in lexicographic order:189total. No degree/interaction selection or clipping learned z.
